title: Puck counters ceilings (puck.counters.ceilings.v1)
description: A puck.counters.ceilings.v1 document: the counted-cost ceilings puck counters --check holds the counters workload to, pass by pass, and puck counters --record writes. Each backend states, for every pass of every render node and for the work outside every pass, what each GPU submission kind may read there: at most its ceiling, where a ceiling of zero is a required zero. The ceilings every device shares (deterministic counts, and required zeros whose count no retained device record owns) are the backend's own; the magnitudes of per-backend-deterministic counts (PerBackendDeterministic), which follow the device, are one record per device, including a newly recorded zero when another retained device owns that count. A run is judged against its backend's shared ceilings and its own device's record.

workload.description: The workload's world document, repository-relative with forward slashes.

script.description: The workload's console script, repository-relative with forward slashes.

width.description: The offscreen presentation's width in pixels.

height.description: The offscreen presentation's height in pixels.

backends.description: One entry per backend, in the order they ran.

items.description: One backend's ceilings: one record per device it was recorded on, and the ceilings every device shares.

devices.description: One record per device, keyed by its adapter (the PCI vendor and device) and its driver implementation (DriverId), in the order they were first recorded; a record of one device never moves another's.

items.description: One device's ceilings on one backend: its per-backend-deterministic readings, including required zeros scoped to it because another retained device record owns the count.

device.description: The device as its run reported it, its driver version among it as recorded evidence: a driver update keeps the record, which the device is still judged against.
device.title: GpuDeviceIdentity

ceilings.description: The device's per-backend-deterministic ceilings. Required zeros scoped to this device follow its other readings; no count also belongs to the backend's shared ceilings.

items.description: What one kind may read in one pass of one render node, or in the work outside its every pass.

pass.description: The pass, or null for the work outside every pass.

kind.description: The GPU submission kind's dotted name.

class.description: What the count was recorded as: the kind's class, loosened to its pass's.
class.title: WorkClass

ceiling.description: The most the count may read; zero requires it to read zero.

requiredZero.description: Whether this zero ceiling belongs to a per-backend-deterministic kind, such as march steps, recorded in that class. It strictly requires zero within its containing record's scope: shared unless another retained device record owns the count, in which case it belongs to the newly recorded device. A deterministic ceiling is shared by its class; a deterministic kind loosened to its pass's class does not carry this flag.

detail.description: The label within the pass, or null for its total or work outside every pass.
